# CriticalRegimeScaling

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A dynamical regime where neural systems exhibit power-law scaling of fluctuations, indicating operation near a critical point of phase transition. Provides a theoretical framework for designing neuromorphic systems that maintain computational flexibility and sensitivity to input, relevant for in-network processing.
